label: Demand propagation along selected contingent reasons as a route to the local existence PSR
summary:
Draft #2015 added a DemandPilot section to ExistentialInheritance/Solution.lean (commits e34a9d54b..6ad1d0e94, last carried at 98543739d), never compiled or registered. It reused the #312 existence-reason Model and the BruteContingencyParity WhyStance. Definitions: SelectedContingentReason m w selected x y (some selected admitted reason token for x's existence has source y, and y is contingent at w); DemandPropagates (if the stance requires a reason why x exists and x has a selected contingent reason about y, it requires one why y exists). Results: reasonOfHonoredDemand (WhyHonors plus a required and accepted existence fact yields a #312 token); demandAlongSelectedReasons (induction on ReflTransGen moves the demand along a finite selected path); psrFromDemandCoverage (WhyHonors, acceptance of every contingent existence fact, DemandPropagates and coverage of every contingent x by a path from some demanded t give NoBruteContingentExistenceAt m w, the Lean declaration of 608a262d); bruteForcesDemandBreak (an honoring stance that accepts an unexplained y reached from a demanded x violates DemandPropagates); containedExemption (on the unchanged ExistentialInheritance Contained model at world false, a stance demanding a reason only for derivative 0 honors that demand, its reason is about the contingent base, it accepts the base without demanding a reason, 608a262d fails, and DemandPropagates fails).

Why rejected as a registered support option or diagnostic for 608a262d. (1) psrFromDemandCoverage is a genuine short derivation, not a transcription, but its warrant does not go beyond 608a262d restated. Coverage uses ReflTransGen, so it is met by the trivial cover in which every contingent existence is itself demanded; then the premises reduce to: the stance requires and accepts every contingent existence fact and the world honors its demands. WhyHonors is a world-side premise that every demanded, accepted fact has a reason, so this bundle is the local existence PSR presented as an honored stance. A different presentation of the same assumption is not additional evidence (AGENTS.md). Non-trivial coverage would add content only for contingents reachable from a demanded existence; isolated contingents still need direct demand. (2) bruteForcesDemandBreak is the registered parity result 6e7f5afd with path propagation in place of feature uniformity; the ParityMap fork in a1056aab already proves that a stance that requires why t, honors its demands and accepts a brute o is not Uniform for t and o. The path form adds only that the weaker, path-restricted norm also fails. (3) containedExemption shows that the contained-bruteness rival honors a restricted demand while denying 608a262d and DemandPropagates. That the brute rival is consistent with an honoring stance is already witnessed by the parity map and b2SupportControls (4c79358e); the countermodel shows the norm is needed in one formal interpretation, not that the rival is false. None of the three discriminates between 608a262d and the brute-contingency rival.

Positive residue kept here, not in Lean: DemandPropagates is strictly weaker than uniformity in the feature 'contingent existence fact', and it is the stance-level form of the explanatory buck-passing intuition. A rival that cites a contingent y as the reason for x and then exempts y must deny it. Its warrant is the open question; it is not the stance's own requirement. The regress and termination side is already covered by existing results: ContingentAncestry.necessaryAncestor (ead7c30a), ExplanatoryClosure certificate (f85ac952), WeakAccountNecessaryBeing.necessaryBeing (56278c18) and DerivativeJointPower.trap_obstruction. The tooling half of #2015 moved to PR #2185.
blocker: A discriminating test needs either (a) independent warrant that the selected reason token is a genuine actual existential input of the target, so that DemandPropagates follows from what explaining x's existence requires rather than from the stance's choice, or (b) an argument that a stance honoring a demand for one contingent existence is committed to propagation without presupposing 608a262d. Reopen with such a bridge into the existing grounding/foundedness interfaces (necessaryAncestor, WeakAccountNecessaryBeing) or the inductive-supply interface (DerivativeJointPower).
